Some species of whale have become extinct because of overexploitation and the population of many of the existing species is dangerously low. Commercial whaling is severely restricted.

definition.ar: نشاط تجاري لبيع السلع إلى تجار التجزئة بكميات أكبر من تلك التي تباع للمستهلك النهائي ولكن بكميات أصغر مما يتم شراؤه من المصنع.
definition.en: The business of selling goods to retailers in larger quantities than they are sold to final consumers but in smaller quantities than they are purchased from manufacturers.

definition.ar: حيوانات غير مستأنسة تعيش مستقلة عن الإنسان.
definition.en: Not domesticated animals living independently of man.

definition.ar: الحيوانات والطيور التي تنمو مستقلة عن الإنسان وعادة ما يكون ذلك في ظروف طبيعية.
definition.en: Animals and plants that grow independently of people, usually in natural conditions.

definition.ar: سلسلة من التدابير المطلوبة للحفاظ على المواطن الطبيعية وتعداد الأنواع المختلفة من صور الحياة البرية النباتية والحيوانية في أوضاع مواتية أو استعادة هذه المواطن.
definition.en: A series of measures required to maintain or restore the natural habitats and the populations of species of wild fauna and flora at a favourable status.

definition.ar: أماكن مواتية في المرتفعات أو الأراضي الرطبة لتعزيز بقاء الحياة البرية.
definition.en: Suitable upland or wetland areas promoting survival of wildlife.

name.fr: statistiques sur les populations d'animaux sauvages

definition.ar: الحقائق أو البيانات الرقمية المجموعة بواسطة العديد من المناهج مثل مسوح المشاهدة، التي تمثل أو تقدر حجم أي نوع من أنواع الحياة البرية لأغراض تحليل اتجاهات التعداد.
definition.en: The numerical facts or data collected through various methodologies, such as sighting surveys, which represent or estimate the size of any wildlife species for purposes such as analyzing population trends.

definition.ar: مادة كيميائية مثل أسيل البيروكسيد العطري أو حمض المونوبيروكسيفثاليك تستخدم لقصر ألوان الدقيق أو الدهون أو الزيوت وغيرها من المواد الغذائية. 2) مادة كيميائية مؤكسدة أو مختزلة مثل هيبوكلوريت الصوديوم أو ثاني أكسيد الكبريت أو سلفيت  الصوديوم الحمضية أو بيروكسيد الهيدروجين.
definition.en:
1) A chemical, such as an aromatic acyl peroxide or monoperoxiphthalic acid, used to bleach flour, fats, oils and other edibles. 
2) An oxidizing or reducing chemical such as sodium hypochlorite, sulfur dioxide, sodium acid sulfite, or hydrogen peroxide.

definition.ar: منطقة توجد عادة في ظروف طبيعية، تخصصها وكالة حكومية أو خاصة لحماية نوع معين من الحيوانات خلال جزء من العام أو طوال العام كله. 2)اى منطقة مخصصة لحماية الحيوانات البرية، يحظر فيها صيد الحيوانات والأسماك أو يخضع لضوابط صارمة.
definition.en:
1) An area, usually in natural condition, which is reserved (set aside) by a governmental or private agency for the protection of particular species of animals during part or all of the year. 
2) An area designated for the protection of wild animals, within which hunting and fishing is either prohibited or strictly controlled.

definition.ar: الحالة الطبيعية أو صفة أو حالة عدم الاستئناس أو عدم الترويض أو عدم التمدين.
definition.en: A state of nature or a quality or state of being undomesticated, untamed or uncultivated.

definition.ar: نباتات تنمو في حالة طبيعية (أي أنها غير مستزرعة).
definition.en: Plants growing in a natural state (not cultivated).

definition.ar: حركة الهواء بالنسبة لسطح الأرض. وتعني عادة حركة الهواء الأفقية في مقابل الحركة الرأسية.
definition.en: The motion of air relative to the earth's surface; usually means horizontal air motion, as distinguished from vertical motion.

definition.ar: طمي قابل لامتزاز الزيوت والمبيدات الحشرية وأشباه القلويات والفيتامينات والنشويات وغيرها من المواد امتزازا كيميائيا، ويستخدم لتكرير الزيوت المعدنية والنباتية وإزالة اللون منها.
definition.en: Clay capable of chemically adsorbing oils, insecticides, alkaloids, vitamins, carbohydrates and other materials; it is used for refining and decolorizing mineral and vegetable oils.

definition.ar: تفتت الصخور الصلبة وتحولها إلى جسيمات صغيرة تحملها الرياح. وقد تظهر في أي تربة سطحها جاف وغير محمي بالغطاء النباتي (الذي يثبتها عند مستوى الجذور ويقي سطحها) وتتألف من جسيمات خفيفة. وتتضمن الآليات الشائعة في هذه العملية التقاط حبيبات الغبار والتربة عند هبوب الرياح وخلخلة أو كشط المادة السطحية بتأثير الحبيبات المحمولة أصلا في الجو.
definition.en: The breakdown of solid rock into smaller particles and its removal by wind. It may occur on any soil whose surface is dry, unprotected by vegetation (to bind it at root level and shelter the surface) and consists of light particles. The mechanisms include straightforward picking up of dust and soil particles by the airflow and the dislodging or abrasion of surface material by the impact of particles already airborne.

definition.ar: ماكينة للطحن أو الضخ تعمل بمجموعة من الريشات أو الأشرعة القابلة للتعديل تدور بقوة الرياح.
definition.en: A machine for grinding or pumping driven by a set of adjustable vanes or sails that are caused to turn by the force of the wind.

definition.ar: الطاقة المستمدة من الرياح وهي تقليديا الطاقة التي تأتي من طواحين الهواء. ولكن شيئا فشيئا أصبحت هناك تصميمات أكثر تعقيدا تتضمن التوربينات التي تولد الكهرباء عموما لكنها تستخدم أيضا لضخ المياه. وتتناسب القوة المتاحة من الرياح مع المساحة التي يغطيها المكان الدوار ومكعب سرعة الرياح، ولكن أقل من نصف الطاقة المتاحة هو الذي يمكن استرداده.
definition.en: Energy extracted from wind, traditionally in a windmill, but increasingly by more complicated designes including turbines, usually to produce electricity but also for water pumping. The power available from wind is proportional to the area swept by the rotating place and the cube of the wind velocity, but less than half the available power can be recovered.

definition.ar: محطة طاقة تستخدم الرياح لتشغيل توربين يولد الكهرباء.
definition.en: Power station which uses wind to drive a turbine which creates electricity.

definition.ar: إزالة المكونات اللونية من النسيج. وتشمل مواد التبييض الشائعة بيروكسيد الهيدروجين وهيبو كلوريد الصوديوم وكلوريت الصوديوم. 2) تفتيح لون لب الورق وإزالة الليفنين منه بإضافة كيماويات مؤكسدة مثل الكلور أو كيماويات مختزلة مثل هيبو كلوريد الصوديوم.
definition.en:
1) Removing colored components from a textile. Common bleaches are hydrogen peroxide, sodium hypochloride, and sodium chlorite. 
2) The brightening and delignification of pulp by the addition of oxidizing chemicals such as chlorine or reducing chemicals such as sodium hypochloride.

definition.ar: أنثى الإنسان الناضجة.
definition.en: An adult human female.

definition.ar: الوضع الاجتماعي أو المركز أو الأهمية النسبية للنساء في المجتمع.
definition.en: The social position, rank or relative importance of women in society.

definition.ar: الخشب، خصوصا باعتباره مادة من مواد البناء.
definition.en: A wood, especially when regarded as a construction material.

definition.ar: نمو كثيف من الأشجار أكبر من الأيكة وأصغر من الغابة.
definition.en: A dense growth of trees more extensive than a grove and smaller than a forest.

definition.ar: نسيج ضام مائع يتألف من البلازما والخلايا التي تدور في الأوعية الدموية.
definition.en: A fluid connective tissue consisting of the plasma and cells that circulate in the blood vessels.

definition.ar: الإزالة الدائمة لمساحة من الغابة أو الأراضي المشجرة بقطع أشجارها تماما.على المنحدرات الحادة يمكن أن يؤدي ذلك إلى تآكل خطير للتربة، خصوصا عندما تؤدي الأمطار الموسمية الغزيرة أو ذوبان الثلوج على الارتفاعات العالية إلى انهمار غزير للمياه. أما في المناطق المدارية الرطبة فقد يؤدي أيضا إلى إطلاق ثاني أكسيد الكربون من التربة.
definition.en: The permanent clear-felling of an area of forest or woodland. On steep slopes this can lead to severe soil erosion, especially where heavy seasonal rains or the melting of snow at higher levels cause sudden heavy flows of water. In the humid tropics it may also lead to a release of carbon dioxide from the soil.

definition.ar: النظام التفاعلي للمجتمع الإيكولوجي والجمادات المحيطة به في البيئة في المناطق المشجرة أو أراضي اليابسة التي تكسوها الأشجار والشجيرات.
definition.en: The interacting system of a biological community and its non-living environmental surroundings in wooded areas or land areas covered with trees and shrubs.

definition.ar: استخدام الكيماويات لمنع أو تأخير تحلل الخشب، خاصة بواسطة الفطريات أو الحشرات. وتتضمن المواد الحافظة المستخدمة على نطاق واسع الكريوسوت والزفت وفلوريد الصوديوم والقار. وتستخدم خصوصا مع الخشب الملامس للأرض.
definition.en: The use of chemicals to prevent or retard the decay of wood, especially by fungi or insects; widely used preservatives include creosote, pitch, sodium fluoride and tar; especially used on wood having contact with the ground.

definition.ar: نفايات متخلفة عن معالجة الأخشاب الخام.
definition.en: Waste which is left over after the processing of raw timber.

definition.ar: ألياف نسجية مصنوعة من الصوف الخام وتتميز بالقدرة على الامتصاص واسترداد الشكل الأصلي والعزل.
definition.en: A textile fiber made from raw wool characterized by absorbency, resiliency and insulation.

definition.ar: حادث يقع في أثناء العمل بسبب عوامل أصيلة في العمل أو مرتبطة به وتتصل بتشغيل المواد الخاصة بمهنة الإنسان.
definition.en: Accident occurring in the course of the employment and caused by inherent or related factors arising from the operation of materials of one's occupation.

definition.ar: منجم استخرج منه كل المعدن الذي يمكن استغلاله استغلالا مربحا.
definition.en: A mine where all the mineral that could be profitably exploited has been removed.

definition.ar: كل الظروف الموجودة التي تؤثر على موقع العمل، ومنها ساعات العمل والجوانب الفيزيائية والحقوق والمسؤوليات القانونية.
definition.en: All existing circumstances affecting labor in the workplace, including job hours, physical aspects, legal rights and responsibilities.

definition.ar: الوقت المخصص للعمل المأجور أو الأنشطة المتعلقة بالوظيفة، وعادة ما تحتسب بعدد الساعات في اليوم أو الأسبوع.
definition.en: The time devoted to gainful employment or job-related activities, usually calculated as hours per day or per week.

definition.ar: حرث التربة للأغراض الزراعية.
definition.en: Ploughing the soil for agricultural purposes.

definition.ar: أي موقع أو بيئة أو كل المواقع والبيئات حيث يعمل الناس.
definition.en: Any or all locations or environments where people are employed.

definition.ar: الأرض وسكانها وكل ما عليها.
definition.en: The Earth with all its inhabitants and all things upon it.

definition.ar: مواقع ذات أهمية ثقافية كبرى ومناطق جغرافية ذات قيمة عالمية فائقة. وتتضمن الأهرامات في مصر والأخدود العظيم في الولايات المتحدة وتاج محل في الهند، وسور الصين العظيم، إلخ.
definition.en: Sites of great cultural significance and geographic areas of outstanding universal value. They include the Pyramids of Egypt, the Grand Canyon of United States, the Taj Mahal of India, the Great Wall of China, etc.

definition.ar: إجراء محاسبي يستخدم عندما تكون الأصول غير قابلة للتحصيل ومن ثم تشطب باعتبارها خسارة.
definition.en: Accounting procedure that is used when an asset is uncollectible and is therefore charged-off as a loss.

definition.ar: كائنات متناهية الدقة كانت تصنف فيما مضى على أنها طحالب لكنها تعد الآن بكتيريا، وتتضمن النوستك الذي يحتوي على صبغة زرقاء إلى جانب الكلوروفيل (اليخضور).
definition.en: Microorganisms, formerly classified as algae but now regarded as bacteria, including nostoc, which contain a blue pigment in addition to chlorophyll.

definition.ar: عمل ضد قواعد العدالة الطبيعية أو القانونية.
definition.en: An act contrary to the rules of natural or legal justice.

definition.ar: تصرف يقوم به مسؤول أو عميل حكومي خلال ممارسته سلطات شرطية أو دستورية أو تشريعية أو إدارية أو قضائية بحيث يتعدى على حقوق شخص آخر ويسبب له الضرر دون حماية حق مناظر أو أعلى منه.
definition.en: A deed performed by a government official or agent in exercise of police, constitutional, legislative, administrative or judicial powers that infringes upon the rights of another and causes damage, without protecting an equal or superior right.

definition.ar: مادة لا توجد في الاحوال الطبيعية في بيئة معينة، وتعني عادة المواد الكيماوية السامة الصناعية تماما، مثل المركبات الأروماتية المكلورة أو مركبات الزئبق العضوية.
definition.en: A substance which would not normally be found in a given environment, and usually means a toxic chemical which is entirely artificial, such as a chlorinated aromatic compound or an organomercury compound.

definition.ar: إشعاع مغناطيسي له القدرة على اختراق الأجسام، يتولد عادة بتسريع الإلكترونات حتى تصل إلى سرعة عالية ثم إيقافها فجأة عن طريق صدمها بجسم صلب، أو بانتقال المدارات الداخلية للذرات التي يزيد عددها الذري عن 10. ويتراوح طولها الموجي بين 10(-5) أنجستروم إلى 10(3) أنجستروم، أما متوسط الطول الموجي المستخدم في البحوث فهو 1 أنجستروم.
definition.en: A penetrating electromagnetic radiation, usually generated by accelerating electrons to high velocity and suddenly stopping them by collision with a solid body, or by inner-shell transitions of atoms with atomic number greater than 10; their wavelength ranges from about 10(-5) angstrom to 10(3) angstroms, the average wavelength used in research being 1 angstrom.

definition.ar: أنواع كثيرة من الفطريات أحادية الخلية. معظمها ينتمي للفطريات الزقية ويتكاثر بالتبرعم. يستخدم النوع السكيري منها في صنع  الجعة والنبيذ  لأنه عند التركيز المنخفض للأكسجين ينتج نظاما للإنزيمات يكسر السكريات إلى كحول وثاني أكسيد الكربون. كما يستخدم النوع السكيري في صنع الخبز. وتستخدم بعض أنواع الخميرة كمصدر للبروتين وفيتامينات من المجموعة ب.
definition.en: Many species of unicellular fungi, most of which belong to the Ascomycetes and reproduce by budding. The genus Saccharomyces is used in brewing and winemaking because in low oxygen concentration it produces zymase, an enzyme system that breaks down sugars to alcohol and carbon dioxide. Saccharomyces is also used in bread-making. Some yeasts are used as a source of protein and of vitamins of the B group.

definition.ar: فائدة أو دخل ناتج عن استثمار أو معاملات تجارية.
definition.en: Profit or income created through an investment or a business transaction.

definition.ar: طفل صغير في السنوات الأولى من العمر.
definition.en: A young child in the first years of life.

definition.ar: حالة الشباب. الفترة التي تقع بين الطفولة وسن النضوج.
definition.en: The state of being young; the period between childhood and adult age.

definition.ar: فرص للعمل والتوظيف للمراهقين. إما من أجل الربح المالي أو الفائدة التعليمية.
definition.en: Job opportunities and employment for adolescents, either for financial reward or educational enrichment.

definition.ar: معدن فلزي هش أبيض مائل للزرقة، يكتسي بطبقة مقاومة للتآكل في الهواء الرطب ويظهر أساسا في صورة السفاليرايت والسمثسونايت. مكون من مكونات العديد من السبائك خصوصا النحاس الأصفر والنيكل-الفضة، ويستخدم في السبك في القوالب وفي طلاء المعادن وفي أقطاب البطاريات.
definition.en: A brittle bluish-white metallic element that becomes coated with a corrosion-resistant layer in moist air and occurs chiefly in sphalerite and smithsonite. It is a constituent of several alloys, especially brass and nickel-silver, and is used in die-casting, galvanizing metals, and in battery electrodes.
Designation and reservation under a master plan of land use for light and heavy industry, dwellings, offices, and other buildings; use is enforced by restrictions on types of buildings in each zone.
definition.ar: تحديد استخدامات الأراضي وفقا لخطة رئيسية لتخصيص مساحات للصناعات الخفيفة والثقيلة، وأخرى للمساكن والمكاتب وغيرها من المباني. ويتعزز استخدام الأراضي بوضع قيود على أنواع المباني في كل منطقة.
مكان يحتفظ فيه بالحيوانات، وخاصة الحيوانات البرية حتى يزورها الناس لمشاهدتها أو دراستها.
definition.en: Area in which animals, especially wild animals, are kept so that people can go and look at them, or study them.

definition.ar: دراسة الحيوانات، بما في ذلك تصنيفها وبنيتها وفسيولوجيتها وتاريخها.
definition.en: The study of animals, including their classification, structure, physiology, and history.

definition.ar: الأمراض التي تكيفت حيويا فأصبح من المعتاد أن يصاب بها الحيوان، ولكنها في ظروف معينة قد تنتقل للإنسان.
definition.en: Diseases which are biologically adapted to and normally found in animals but which under some conditions also infect man.

definition.ar: السفر أو الخروج إلى البحر في قارب على سبيل الترفيه.
definition.en: To travel or go in a boat as a form of recreation.

definition.ar: كمية الاكسجين المستخدمة في الأكسدة الكيميائية الحيوية لكل وحدة من وحدات الحجم من الماء عند درجة حرارة معينة ولمدة معينة. ويعتبر الطلب على الأكسجين الحيوي مؤشرا على درجة التلوث العضوي في الماء.
definition.en: The amount of oxygen used for biochemical oxidation by a unit volume of water at a given temperature and for a given time. BOD is an index of the degree of organic pollution in water.

definition.ar: إدارة أو توجيه شئون منصب أو عمل تجاري أو مؤسسة في القطاع العام أو الخاص.
definition.en: The management or direction of the affairs of a public or private office, business or organization.

definition.ar: وعاء مغلق يتم فيه تسخين الماء وتدويره إما في صورة ماء ساخن أو بخار، بغرض التدفئة أو إنتاج الطاقة.
definition.en: An enclosed vessel in which water is heated and circulated, either as hot water or as steam, for heating or power.

definition.ar: درجة الحرارة التي يحدث عندها تحول السائل إلى الحالة الغازية بالنسبة للمواد النقية تحت ضغط معين.
definition.en: The temperature at which the transition from the liquid to the gaseous phase occurs in a pure substance at fixed pressure.

definition.ar: مجموعة من الأوراق أو الرقائق أو غير ذلك من المواد التي تجلد عادة أو تثبت بين دفتين، وتحوي كتابات من أي نوع، أو قد تكون صفحات خالية لُيتْكَب فيها فيما بعد.
definition.en: A collection of leaves of paper, parchment or other material, usually bound or fastened together within covers, containing writing of any type or blank pages for future inscription.

definition.ar: الفن أو العلم المختص بتسجيل حسابات ومعاملات الأعمال التجارية.
definition.en: The art or science of recording business accounts and transactions.

definition.ar: الخط الفاصل بين المناطق السياسية أو الجغرافية.
definition.en: The dividing line or frontier between political or geographic regions.

definition.ar: عنصر بللوري شبه قلوي شديد الصلابة عديم اللون تقريبا يوجد في صورته غير النقية على هيئة مسحوق بني لابللوري. ويظهر أساسا في البوراكس ويستخدم في تقسية الصلب.
definition.en: A very hard almost colourless crystalline metalloid element that in impure form exists as a brown amorphous powder. It occurs principally in borax and is used in hardening steel.

definition.ar: مكان لزراعة النباتات ودراستها وعرضها.
definition.en: A place in which plants are grown, studied and exhibited.

definition.ar: أحد فروع العلوم الحيوية يتناول دراسة النباتات وحياة النبات.
definition.en: A branch of the biological sciences which embraces the study of plants and plant life.

definition.ar: اجتياز حدود دولة من الدول.
definition.en: Crossing of a state border.

definition.ar: طبقة في الموائع مجاورة للحد الفيزيائي الذي تتأثر عنده حركة المائع تأثرا كبيرا بالحد وتتميز بمتوسط سرعة أدنى من قيمة التيار الحر.
definition.en: The layer of fluid adjacent to a physical boundary in which the fluid motion is significantly affected by the boundary and has a mean velocity less than the free stream value.

definition.ar: أي حيوان ينتمي إلى فصيلة البقريات.
definition.en: Any animal belonging to the Bovidae family.

definition.ar: مياة ملحة يقع تركيزها بين تركيز الماء العذب وماء البحر، وعادة ما يكون ذلك بمقدار 5-10 أجزاء لكل ألف جزء.
definition.en: Water, salty between the concentrations of fresh water and sea water; usually 5-10 parts x thousand.

definition.ar: عدم استقرار رأسي مستمر لفترة طويلة وشديد البطء في القشرة الأرضية، كما في المناطق البركانية غرب نابولي بإيطاليا حيث أدى اختلاج الحقول الفليغرية إلى تحرك القشرة الأرضية إلى أعلى وإلى أسفل لمسافة تتراوح بين 6 أمتار تحت سطح البحر و6 أمتار فوقه على مدى فترة زمنية تزيد على ألفي عام.
definition.en: A long-continued, extremely slow vertical instability of the crust, as in the volcanic district west of Naples, Italy, where the Phlegraean bradyseism has involved up-and-down movements between 6 m below sea level and 6 m above over a period of more than 2.000 years.

definition.ar: لبن الثدي الذي يرضع منه الأطفال.
definition.en: Milk from the breast for feeding babies.

definition.ar: تطبيق مبادئ الوراثة على تحسين أنواع حيوانات المزارع والنباتات المستزرعة.
definition.en: The application of genetic principles to the improvement of farm animals and cultivated plants.

definition.ar: الأفراد من جماعات الطير المستخدمة للإكثار خلال فترة معينة في مكان معين.
definition.en: The individuals in a bird population that are involved in reproduction during a particular period in a given place.

definition.ar: قطاع من الاقتصاد تعنى فيه مجموعة من المشروعات التجارية بتصنيع وتسويق المشروبات المصنعة من الشعير وحشيشة الدينار عن طريق النقع والغلي والتخمير، مثل البيرة والجعة وغيرها من المشروبات المتصلة بها.
definition.en: A sector of the economy in which an aggregate of commercial enterprises is engaged in the manufacture and marketing of beverages made from malt and hops by steeping, boiling and fermentation, such as beer, ale and other related beverages.
A building material usually made from clay, molded as a rectangular block, and baked or burned in a kiln.
definition.ar: مادة للبناء تصنع عادة من الطمي الذي يشكل بوضعه في قوالب مستطيلة ثم يجفف أو يحرق في قمائن خاصة.

definition.en: all living biomass above the soil including stem, stump, branches, bark, seeds and foliage
definition.fr:
toute biomasse vivante au-dessus du sol, y compris les tiges, les souches, les 
branches, l’écorce, les graines et le feuillage

definition.en: oven-dry weight of net annual increment (s.b) of a tree, stand or forest plus oven-dry weight of annual growth of branches, twigs, foliage, top and stump
all living matter above-ground excluding trees with trees defined as generally five cm or greater diameter at breast height (4.3 feet above ground)
all living matter composed of trees defined as generally five cm or greater diameter at breast height (4.3 feet above ground)

The process of adjustment to actual or expected climate and its effects. In human systems, adaptation seeks to moderate or avoid harm or exploit beneficial opportunities. In some natural systems, human intervention may facilitate adjustment to expected climate and its effects.

The property of a system to adjust its characteristics or behaviour, in order to expand its coping range under existing climate variability, or future climate conditions. 
ACC definition: The ability of systems, institutions, humans, and other organisms to
adjust to potential damage, to take advantage of opportunities, or to
respond to consequences.

name.fr: production de bioénergie fondée sur l'agriculture

definition.en: oil crops which are converted into biofuels
definition.fr: oléagineux transformés en biocarburants

definition.en: any substance added to a fertiliser, soil improver or growing medium to improve the agronomic efficacy of the final product, or modify the environmental fate of the nutrients released by the fertilisers
definition.fr: toute substance ajoutée à un engrais,  un amendement du sol ou un milieu de culture pour renforcer l'efficacité agronomique du produit final, ou pour modifier le devenir dans l'environnement des nutriments libérés par les engrais

name.fr: guide des inventaires des émissions de polluants atmosphériques

definition.en: joint EMEP/EEA guidebook supporting the reporting of emissions data, under the UNECE Convention on Long-range Transboundary Air Pollution (CLRTAP) and the EU National Emission Ceilings Directive, in providing expert guidance on how to compile an atmospheric emissions inventory
definition.fr: guide commun EMEP/AEE à l'appui de la communication des données relatives aux émissions, au titre de la Convention sur la pollution atmosphérique transfrontière à longue distance (CPATLD) et de la directive de l'UE sur les plafonds d'émission nationaux, fournissant des orientations d'experts sur la façon de dresser un inventaire des émissions atmosphériques

name.fr: directives sur la qualité de l'air

definition.en: Directive that define the legislative basis for the assessment and management of air quality in Member States
definition.fr: directives qui définissent la base législative de l'évaluation et de la gestion de la qualité de l'air dans les États membres

definition.en: Ratio of the radiation (radiant or luminous energy) reflected by a surface to that incident on it.
any algae-based biofuel
The quality of outdoor air in our surrounding environment. It is typically measured near ground level, away from direct sources of pollution.

A naturally occurring biochemical process in which organic
material is broken down by bacteria in an oxygen-free environment.

type of liquid storage system designed and operated to combine waste stabilization and storage with varying lengths of storage (up to a year or greater), depending on the climate region, the volatile solids loading rate, and other operational factors

proper handling, storage, and utilization of wastes generated from animal confinement operations, including means of collecting, scraping, or washing wastes from confinement areas into appropriate waste storage structures
definition.fr: traitement, stockage et utilisation appropriés des déchets résultant des opérations de confinement d'animaux, y compris les moyens de collecter, de gratter ou de laver les déchets présents dans les zones de confinement pour les stocker dans des structures appropriées

definition.en:
combination of structural and nonstructural practices
serving a feedlot that provides for the collection, treatment, storage or land applications of animal waste

Emissions of greenhouse gases, greenhouse gas precursors, and
aerosols caused by human activities. These activities include the burning
of fossil fuels, deforestation, land use changes, livestock production,
fertilization, waste management, and industrial processes.
group of interacting organisms dependent on one another and their water environment for nutrients (e.g., nitrogen and phosphorus) and shelter
total of built-up areas plus artificial non-built-up areas
definition.fr: total des zones bâties et des zones artificialisées non bâties

definition.en: suspensions of solids and/or liquid particles in the air that we breathe, as dust, smoke and haze, measured by the mass concentration of aerosol particles or by an optical measure
primary source of carbon in life on Earth and its concentration in Earth's pre-industrial atmosphere since late in the Precambrian was regulated by photosynthetic organisms and geological phenomena

Atmospheric deposition or flux of total reactive nitrogen (N) to the Earth’s surface, calculated for example as kilograms N per hectare and year (kg N ha-1 yr-1). Reactive N from the atmosphere can be deposited as gases (= dry deposition) and in precipitation (= wet deposition). Total reactive N includes oxidised N compounds as well as reduced N compounds. Oxidised compounds are here mainly nitrogen oxides (NOx; gases) and nitrate (NO3-; in precipitation). The main reduced compounds are ammonia (NH3; gas) and ammonium (NH4+; in precipitation)
area between Novaya Zemlia, in the east, and the line Norway–Bear Island–South Spitsbergen, in the west  area
definition.fr: zone située entre la Nouvelle-Zemble, à l'est, et la ligne Norvège-Île aux Ours-Sud Spitzberg à l'ouest

name.fr: directive sur les eaux de baignade

definition.en: rules laid down by the European Union (EU) for the monitoring, assessment and management of the quality of bathing water, and for the provision of information on that quality to reduce and prevent the pollution of bathing water and to inform European citizens of the degree of pollution
definition.fr: règles fixées par l'Union européenne (UE) pour la surveillance, l'évaluation et la gestion de la qualité des eaux de baignade ainsi que la fourniture d'informations sur la qualité de ces eaux afin de réduire et prévenir la pollution des eaux de baignade et d'informer les Européens sur leur degré de pollution

name.fr: législation sur les eaux de baignade

definition.en: European legislation aimed at safeguarding public health and protecting the aquatic environment in coastal and inland areas from pollution
definition.fr: législation européenne visant à sauvegarder la santé publique et à protéger de la pollution le milieu aquatique aussi bien en zones côtières que fluviale

definition.en: Transformation or modification of human behavior
all living biomass of live roots
definition.fr: toute biomasse de racines vivantes

definition.en: Growth in below-ground biomass including coarse roots and root collar
definition.fr: croissance de la biomasse souterraine, y compris les racines grossières et le collet de la racine

definition.en: ambient temperature under mild reaction conditions and use of special aerobic anaerobic microorganisms

The capacity of ecosystems to regenerate what people demand from those surfaces. The biocapacity of a particular surface represents its ability to renew what people demand. Biocapacity is therefore the ecosystems' capacity to produce biological materials used by people and to absorb waste material generated by humans, under current management schemes and extraction technologies. Biocapacity can change from year to year due to climate, management, and also what portions are considered useful inputs to the human economy.

Planned management (i.e. preservation, maintenance, sustainable use, recovery, enhancement) of a natural resources or of a particular ecosystem to halt, reverse or slow-down the loss of biodiversity from impacts of exploitation, pollution etc. to ensure the future usability of the resource, resilience of communities, and ecosystem integrity.
Long term or permanent qualitative or quantitative reduction in components of biodiversity and their potential to provide goods and services, to be measured at global, regional and national levels

conserving the resilience and vitality of natural ecosystems both for their intrinsic value and also for the benefits that they provide to human society as healthy ecosystems constitute our best defence against the worst extremes of weather associated with climate change
New and quickly developing branch of industry in most of European countries to find different efficient solution of energy conversion from different biomass recourses
Conversion of biomass to biofuel

The variability among living organisms from all sources including, inter alia, terrestrial, marine and other aquatic ecosystems and the ecological complexes of which they are part; this includes diversity within species, between species and of ecosystems

Any organic matter in waste which can be broken down into carbon dioxide, water, methane or simple organic molecules by micro-organisms and other living things using composting, aerobic digestion, anaerobic digestion or similar processes
Biomass burning is the burning of living and dead vegetation
Plant and algal materials used to derive fuels like ethanol, butanol, biodiesel, and other hydrocarbon fuels
effects that the organisms in a community have on one another that are fundamental to the survival of that organism and the functioning of the ecosystem as a whole

Carbon captured by the world's oceans and coastal ecosystems.The carbon captured by living organisms in oceans is stored in the form of biomass and sediments from mangroves, salt marshes, seagrasses and potentially algae.
long-term EU strategy to support growth in the maritime sector as a whole
definition.fr: stratégie à long terme visant à soutenir la croissance durable dans le secteur maritime dans son ensemble

definition.en: phenomena of a stand of trees losing health and dying without an obvious cause
Process of identifying and quantifying carbon in form of carbon dioxide (CO2) added to or removed from the earth's atmosphere, natural and human activity
economy based on low carbon power sources that therefore has a minimal output of greenhouse gas emissions into the environment biosphere, but specifically refers to the greenhouse gas carbon dioxide.
gas that contributes to the greenhouse effect by absorbing infrared radiation

The situation that may occur if, for reasons of costs related to climate policies, businesses were to transfer production to other countries with laxer emission constraints. This could lead to an increase in their total emissions. The risk of carbon leakage may be higher in certain energy-intensive industries.
total of carbon emissions and carbon sequestration over a period of time for a defined area, project or sector
biological process that absorbs carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and contains it in living organic matter, soil, or aquatic ecosystems
quantity of carbon in a “pool”, meaning a reservoir or system which has the capacity to accumulate or release carbon
definition.fr: quantité de carbone dans un «bassin», à savoir un réservoir ou un système pouvant accumuler ou libérer le carbone

definition.en: maximum supply of biological products and services that can be provided by the natural environment so that renewable resources are not depleted faster than they can be regenerated and that ecological systems remain viable
definition.fr: quantité maximale de produits et services biologiques que l'environnement naturel peut fournir sans que les ressources renouvelables ne soient utilisées à un rythme supérieur à leur rythme de regénération et en garantissant la viabilité des systèmes écologiques

definition.en: waste arising from any trade or business, industrial or commercial activities
definition.fr: déchets résultant de tout commerce ou entreprise, de toute activité industrielle ou commerciale

definition.en: An economy in which the value of products, materials and resources is maintained in the economy for as long as possible, and the generation of waste minimised
Consequences of climate change on natural and human systems
definition.fr: conséquences du changement climatique sur les systèmes naturels et humains

name.fr: politique en matière de changement climatique

definition.en: government or private actions designed to lower anthropogenic greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, or to adapt to climate change
definition.fr: actions prises par les gouvernements ou des entités privées pour diminuer les émissions anthropiques de gaz à effet de serre (GES), ou pour s'adapter au changement climatique

definition.en: Influence of land cover and biological mediated processes that regulate atmospheric processes and weather patterns which in turn create the microclimate in which different plants and animals (including humans) live and function
any of the eight principal zones, roughly demarcated by lines of latitude, into which the earth can be divided on the basis of climate
definition.fr: chacune des huit zones principales de la Terre, délimitées de manière approximative par les lignes de latitude, qui se distingue par son climat

definition.en: any waste that consists wholly or partly of Human or animal tissue, Blood or bodily fluids, Excretions, Drugs or other pharmaceutical products, Swabs or dressings, Syringes, needles or other sharp instruments which, unless rendered safe, may prove hazardous to any person coming into contact with it
Flooding of normally dry, low-lying coastal land, primarily caused by severe weather events along the coast, estuaries, and adjoining rivers.

ways that allow consumers to obtain products or services more effectively and resource-efficiently, involving fundamentally changing the ways that consumer demands are met, including shifting from individual decisions to organised or collective demand
definition.fr: moyens permettant aux consommateurs d'obtenir des produits ou des services de manière plus efficace et en utilisant au mieux les ressources, qui impliquent un changement fondamental dans la réponse à la demande des consommateurs, y compris le fait de passer de décisions individuelles à une demande organisée ou collective

definition.en: Waste from premises used mainly for the purposes of a trade or business or for the purpose of sport, recreation, education or entertainment, but excluding household, agricultural or industrial waste
mineral materials occurring in the process of demolition, renovation and alteration works on edifices and building parts
definition.fr: matériaux minéraux provenant de travaux de démolition, d’assainissement ou de transformation d’ouvrages ou d’éléments de construction

definition.en: study of individuals, groups, or organizations and the processes they use to select, secure, use, and dispose of products, services, experiences, or ideas to satisfy needs and the impacts that these processes have on the consumer and society

Anaerobic lagoon covered with a flexible membrane to
capture methane produced during the digestion process

Materials left in an agricultural field or orchard after the crop has been harvested. These residues include stalks and stubble (stems), leaves, and seed pods. The residue can be ploughed directly into the ground, or burned first. Good management of field residues can increase efficiency of irrigation and control of erosion.

evidence and longer-term objectives agreed and implemented in cooperation with relevant stakeholders established in a single policy document or in a set of inter-linked policy documents

definition.en: process whereby programmes are carried out, thereby putting plans into practice
definition.fr: processus par lequel des programmes sont réalisés, en mettant les plans en pratique

definition.en: lowering of pollutant releases into the environment measured on the basis of validated information subsequently published in a pollutant release inventory
Fine particulate and/or aerosol matter directly emitted to the atmosphere
energy contained in fossil fuels, and renewable energy sources, not subject to any conversion or transformation process
definition.fr: énergie contenue dans des combustibles fossiles et des sources d'énergie renouvelables n'ayant subi aucun processus de conversion ou de transformation

definition.en: result of a Product Environmental Footprint study based on the Product Environmental Footprint method

name.fr: méthode de l'empreinte environnementale de produit

definition.en: general method to measure and communicate the potential environmental impact of the lifecycle of a product
definition.fr: méthode générale pour mesurer et indiquer l’impact environnemental potentiel d’un produit tout au long de son cycle de vie

definition.en: type of collaborative consumption that reduces the distinction between producer and consumer
definition.fr: type de consommation collaborative qui réduit la distinction entre producteur et consommateur

definition.en: one of a set of seventeen chemical elements in the periodic table, specifically the fifteen lanthanides plus scandium and yttrium

Energy derived from natural processes (e.g. sunlight and wind) that are replenished at a faster rate than they are consumed. Solar, wind, geothermal, hydro, and some forms of biomass are common sources of renewable energy.

name.fr: directive sur les sources d'énergie renouvelables

definition.en: legislation establishing an overall policy for the production and promotion of energy from renewable sources in the EU, requiring Member States to submit national renewable energy Action Plans with detailed roadmaps of how each Member State expects to reach its legally binding 2020 target for the share of renewable energy in their final energy consumption
definition.fr: législation établissant une politique globale pour la production et la promotion d'énergie provenant de sources renouvelables dans l'UE. Elle exige des États membres qu'ils soumettent des plans d’action nationaux en matière d’énergies renouvelables accompagnés de feuilles de route détaillées quant à la façon dont chaque État membre compte atteindre son objectif 2020 juridiquement contraignant pour la part d'énergie renouvelable dans leur consommation finale d'énergie

definition.en: Renewable natural resources are natural resources that, after exploitation, can return to their previous stock levels by natural processes of growth or replenishment.
general classification for the heavier oils that remain after the distillate fuel oils and lighter hydrocarbons are distilled away in refinery operations

The ability of a system, community or society exposed to hazards to resist, absorb, accommodate to and recover from the effects of a hazard in a timely and efficient manner, including through the preservation and restoration of its essential basic structures and functions.

supply-side measures that tackle inefficiencies across supply chains; overuse of resources and waste when products and services are produced. Being more material resource efficient means using less to produce the same level of output
ratio between gross domestic product (GDP) and domestic material consumption (DMC)
definition.fr: rapport entre le produit intérieur brut (PIB) et la consommation intérieure de matières (DMC)

definition.en: dearth or rarity of resources, can be also caused by decline in the quality, availability or productivity of natural resources and lead to reduction in economic well-being
appropriation and use of resources, ecosystems and naturally occurring materials, such as soil, wood, water, and minerals
an economy which creates more with less, delivering greater value with less input, using resources in a sustainable way and minimising their impacts on the environment.

area of land
from which all surface run‑off flows through a sequence of streams, rivers or lakes
into the sea at a single river mouth, estuary or delta
definition.fr: zone dans laquelle toutes les eaux de ruissellement convergent à travers un réseau de rivières, fleuves et éventuellement de lacs vers la mer, dans laquelle elles se déversent par une seule embouchure, estuaire ou delta

definition.en: management of the sustainable use of water resources in a river basin, comprising the main river, all its tributaries and ground water, so as to provide for the social, cultural and economic development by taking into account the basics of ecology
environmental noise generated from vehicles using roads and highways caused by rolling and propulsion
definition.fr: bruit dans l'environnement généré par des véhicules utilisant des routes et autoroutes, causé par le roulage et la propulsion

definition.en: The policy that is targeted to help the rural areas of the EU to meet the wide range of economic, environmental and social challenges of the 21st century.
Flowering plants which grow in marine, fully saline environments.

land covered with impermeable materials as a result of urban development, infrastructure construction or change in the nature of the soil, leading to impermeability, loss of agricultural or forestry areas and ecological soil functions severely impaired or prevented (e.g. soil working as a buffer and filter)
any liquid fuel which is derived by or from qualified feedstocks and meets the registration requirements for fuels and fuel additives
Fine particulate and/or aerosol matter that is formed in the atmosphere following the emission of precursor gases
semi-natural and natural ecosystems that are sensitive to both natural and human influence and activities because of the diversity of species they support
natural gas from shale formations

art and science of controlling the establishment, growth, composition, health, and quality of forest and woodlands to meet the diverse needs and values of landowners and society on a sustainable basis
series of physiological changes where juvenile salmonid fish adapt from living in fresh water to living in seawater
capacity of a society to ensure the welfare of all its members, minimising disparities and avoiding polarisation

means ensuring that all communities are treated fairly and are given equal opportunity to participate in the planning and decision-making process, with an emphasis on ensuring that traditionally disadvantaged groups are not left behind
renewable and environmentally safe energy
variation in soil life, from genes to communities, and the ecological complexes of which they are part, that is from soil micro-habitats to landscapes

complex communities of organisms that play fundamental roles in soil formation and contribute, directly or indirectly, to many processes such as nutrient cycling, waste decomposition, soil structure formation and pollination
occurrence of pollutants in soil above a certain level, causing a deterioration or loss of one or more soil functions
household combustion of coal or biomass such as dung, charcoal, wood or crop residues
natural and irrevocable process leading to the death of a species without leaving any progeny and causing complete loss of genetic diversity

use of biomass as an energy resource that contributes to climate change mitigation, energy security, and economic development goals, results in minimal environmental and social impacts, and attains economic self-sufficiency

use of goods and services that respond to basic needs and bring a better quality of life, while minimising the use of natural resources, toxic materials and emissions of waste and pollutants over the life cycle, so as not to jeopardise the needs of future generations

integrated and indivisible goals, defined by the United Nations 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, that are global in nature and universally applicable, taking into account different national realities, capacities and levels of development and respecting national policies and priorities
definition.fr: objectifs intégrés et indivisibles, définis par le programme de développement durable de l’ONU pour 2030, qui sont mondiaux par nature et universellement applicables, compte tenu des différences entre les réalités, les capacités et les niveaux de développement au niveau national et dans le respect des politiques et des priorités nationales

definition.en: sustainable exploitation of the fisheries stock wich will not prejudice the future exploitation or the marine eco-systems

stewardship and use of forests and forest lands in a way, and at a rate, that maintains their biodiversity, productivity, regeneration capacity, vitality and their potential to fulfil, now and in the future, relevant ecological, economic and social functions, at local, national and global levels, and that does not cause damage to other ecosystems
definition.fr: gestion et utilisation des forêts et des terrains boisés d'une manière et à une intensité telles qu'elles maintiennent leur diversité biologique, leur productivité, leur capacité de régénération, leur vitalité et leur capacité à satisfaire, actuellement et dans le futur, les fonctions écologiques, économiques et sociales pertinentes, aux niveaux local, national et mondial, sans causer de préjudice à d'autres écosystèmes

definition.en: increase in per capita real income or real GNP which can be sustained in the long term (i.e. while maintaining macroeconomic stability and keeping pace with demographic changes)

management approach which efficiently integrates economic, environmental and social issues with the aim of creating long-term benefits and securing the support, cooperation, and trust of the local community in a way that will benefit the current and the future generations

use of natural resources in a way and at a rate that does not lead to the long-term decline of biological diversity, thereby maintaining its potential to meet the needs and aspirations of present and future generations
Tourism that takes full account of its current and future economic, social and environmental impacts, addressing the needs of visitors, the industry, the environment and host communities
treatment of animal by-products under the following conditions
new definition: multi-dimensional and fundamental processes of change in socio-technical systems and their interactions with ecosystems
waters between the land and sea, including fjords, estuaries, lagoons, deltas and rias
definition.fr: eaux situées entre la terre et la mer, notamment les fjords, estuaires, lagons, deltas et rias

definition.en: total amount of living organic matter in trees expressed as oven-dry biomass per unit area (usually in tonnes/hectare)
composed of various chemical species

habitats of underground living species buffered from profound climatic modifications and thus retaining a broad diversity of living relicts, the great majority of which being represented by terrestrial, troglobitic species, with a reduced mobility

areas inaccessible to human intervention due to the remoteness of the locations, lands with essentially no development interest or protection due to limited personal, commercial or social value, as well as lands which are potentially of economic value but remain unmanaged due to low population density, remoteness, etc.
variety and richness of living organisms, including genetic variation and habitat diversity, found in and on the edge of human settlements
process of data collection, profile and consultations designed to provide an informational and consensual basis for preparing an urban environmental management strategy
set of transportation and circulation policies and measures which seek to provide ample and democratic access to the urban space, through prioritization of mass transit means of transportation
EU directive aiming to protect the environment from the adverse effects of discharges of waste water from urban areas and industry
treatment of wastewater in urban wastewater plants, usually operated by public authorities or private companies mandated by public authorities
analysis of the expected impacts, risks and the adaptive capacity of a region or sector to the effects of climate change
destruction of waste where the main purpose of the destruction is the thermal treatment of waste in order to reduce the volume and the hazardousness of the waste.
processes in which the gas emissions from waste disposal are converted into harmless substances by means of chemical reactions
any stationary or mobile technical unit and equipment dedicated to the thermal treatment of waste with or without recovery of the combustion heat generated
system developed for the collection, transport, recovery and disposal of waste, including the supervision of such operations and the after-care of disposal sites
process of collecting wastewater from the time it exits residential and industrial sites to the point it arrives at the wastewater treatment plant
infrastructure providing a series of treatment processes aiming to reduce the level of pollution of wastewater received to an acceptable level before discharge into the receiving waters
the output over time of a given major sector per volume of (net) water withdrawn
Directive 2000/60/EC establishing a framework for Community action in the field of water policy
definition.fr: directive 2000/60/CE établissant un cadre pour une politique communautaire dans le domaine de l'eau

definition.en: environmental sustainability in the management of water resources, via integrated ecosystem approaches, access to good quality water in sufficient quantity and contribution to the internationally agreed targets and goals relevant to water and socio-economic development
situation in which water demand exceeds the water resources exploitable under sustainable conditions
sub-optimal disponibility of water which makes impossible to meet human and ecological demand
use of water by agriculture, industry, energy production and households, including in-stream uses such as fishing, recreation, transportation and waste disposal.
relatively untouched natural areas that have not been significantly modified by human activity, including core areas for nature on land or at sea where nature and wildlife thrive
The global capacity of ecosystems to regenerate what people demand from those surfarces

international organisation, directing and coordinating authority for health within the United Nations which supports member states in coordinating funds, foundations, civil society organisations and the private sector to meet health objectives and support national health policies and strategies

Forward-looking approach that aims to help decision-makers explore and anticipate in a participatory way what might happen, as well as prepare for a range of possible future scenarios, influence them and shape the futures. Foresight typically involves systematic, participatory, future-intelligence-gathering and medium-to-long-term vision-building processes to uncover a range of possible alternative future visions. Key foresight methods include horizon scanning and scenario building.

Studies aiming at providing information and advice for shaping the future. The results of forward-looking studies can be fed into the foresight processes, as well as into other strategic decision-making processes, but taken alone they cannot deliver the governance-related benefits that foresight processes offer. Examples of forward-looking studies are environmental outlooks and scenario and megatrend studies.

Written story lines (based on a literature review and on creative and logical thinking of the authors) used as parts of a horizon scan or a scenario study.  A story line consists of a coherent description of several possible or desirable future developments and/or events which can lead to a possible or desirable future.

Forward-looking approach aimed at exploring and predicting a surprise-free future. On the basis of assumed continuity or expected events, trends are projected and extrapolated from the past into the future.  Key forecasting methods are trend-extrapolation techniques and modeling.
waste from accommodation used purely for living purposes and which is disposed of via the normal mixed domestic refuse collection
definition.fr: déchets provenant des habitations et éliminés par l'intermédiaire de la collecte mixte normale des déchets ménagers

definition.en: air pollution that contains a range of health-damaging pollutants, such as small particles and carbon monoxide (CO), and levels of particulate pollutants that can many times be higher than accepted guideline values for indoor spaces
definition.fr: pollution de l'air qui contient  de nombreux polluants nocifs pour la santé, tels que des particules fines et du monoxyde de carbone (CO), et des niveaux de particules polluantes qui peuvent être beaucoup plus élevés que les valeurs de référence communément acceptées pour les espaces intérieurs

name.en: Infrastructure for spatial information in Europe

definition.en: Directive establishing an infrastructure for spatial information in Europe to support Community environmental policies and policies or activities which may have an impact on the environment.
definition.fr: directive établissant une infrastructure d'information géographique en Europe afin de soutenir les politiques environnementales communautaires ainsi que les politiques ou activités pouvant avoir une incidence sur l'environnement

definition.en: waste put on or in the ground
definition.fr: déchets placés sur le sol ou enfouis dans le sol

name.fr: flux de déchets mis en décharge

definition.en: waste which is deposited in landfill, characterised according to the European Waste Catalogue, and which adds to the inventory of landfill already in place,  covering commercial, industrial and household sources, and excluding fractions already recovered for re-use, recycling or incineration
definition.fr: déchets mis en décharge, caractérisés selon le catalogue européen des déchets, et qui s'ajoutent à l'inventaire des décharges déjà en place, couvrant les sources commerciales, industrielles et ménagères, à l'exclusion des fractions déjà récupérées à des fins de réutilisation, de recyclage ou d'incinération

definition.en: organic biodegradable wastewater containing organic pollutants, such as sewage, industrial wastewater and the like
definition.fr: eaux usées organiques biodégradables contenant des polluants, tels que les eaux d'égout, les eaux industrielles usées, etc.

definition.en: use of particular policy instruments, in such a way as to increase the chance to achieve the defined policy target
definition.fr: utilisation de certains instruments politiques, de façon à améliorer les chances d'atteindre l'objectif politique défini

definition.en: change to the global average temperature that can lead to climate change
definition.fr: évolution de la température moyenne mondiale pouvant entraîner un changement climatique

definition.en: abatement end-of-pipe technology, which is fitted to large combustion plants such as power plants
definition.fr: technique de réduction en fin de cycle  adaptée aux grandes installations de combustion telles que les centrales électriques

definition.en: mechanism by which contaminants are moving through the media until they escape the system, namely via the movement of a mass of fluid (air, ocean current) or the transport of pollutants or plankton by such movement
definition.fr: mécanisme par lequel les contaminants circulent dans le milieu jusqu’à leur évacuation du système, notamment par le mouvement d’une masse de fluide (air, courant océanique) ou le transport de polluants ou de plancton par ce mouvement

definition.en: resulting from or produced by human activities
definition.fr: qui résulte des activités humaines ou est produit par celles-ci

definition.en: animal and plant life of a particular region, habitat or geological period
definition.fr: faune et flore d'une région, d'un habitat ou d'une période géologique donnée

definition.en: water network that supports native species, maintains natural ecological processes, prevents flooding, sustains air and water resources and contributes to the health and quality of life of local communities
definition.fr: réseau d’eau qui soutient les espèces indigènes, maintient les processus écologiques naturels, empêche les inondations, maintient les ressources en air et en eau et contribue à la santé et à la qualité de vie des communautés locales

definition.en: non-sustainable financing and investments which support the fossil fuel industry or carbon intensive activities
definition.fr: financements et investissements non durables qui soutiennent l’industrie des combustibles fossiles ou les activités à forte intensité de carbone

name.fr: installation à forte intensité de carbone

definition.en: physical financial asset with direct or indirect exposure to high levels of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, such as assets in the fossil fuel industry, or that are heavily reliant on fossil fuels
definition.fr: actif financier physique présentant une exposition directe ou indirecte à des niveaux élevés d’émission de gaz à effet de serre (GES), tels que les actifs de l’industrie des combustibles fossiles, ou fortement dépendants des combustibles fossiles

definition.en: recycling, reuse, refurbishment and remanufacturing to reduce the generation of waste as well as the economy's dependence on extraction and imports of raw materials
definition.fr: recyclage, réutilisation, remise à neuf et refabrication visant à réduire la production de déchets ainsi que la dépendance de l’économie à l’égard de l’extraction et des importations de matières premières

definition.en:
scientific work undertaken by members of the general public, often
in collaboration with or under the direction of professional scientists and scientific
institutions
definition.fr: travaux scientifiques menés par des membres du grand public, souvent en collaboration ou sous la direction de scientifiques professionnels et d’institutions scientifiques

definition.en: bonds whose issue is linked to projects with a positive impact on the environment, such as energy efficiency, the production of energy from renewable sources and sustainable land use
definition.fr: obligation dont l’émission est liée à des projets ayant un impact positif sur l’environnement, comme l’efficacité énergétique, la production d’énergie à partir de sources renouvelables et l’utilisation durable des terres

name.fr: indice de référence en matière de climat

definition.en: investment benchmark that incorporates, next to financial investment objectives, specific objectives related to greenhouse gas emission reductions and the transition to a low-carbon economy through the selection and weighting of underlying benchmark constituents
definition.fr: schéma de référence d’investissement qui incorpore, en regard des objectifs d’investissement financier, des objectifs spécifiques liés à la réduction des émissions de gaz à effet de serre et à la transition vers une économie à faible intensité de carbone par la sélection et la pondération des constituants de référence sous-jacents

definition.en: human activities which  result in no net effect on the climate system by balancing residual emissions with emission (carbon dioxide) removal as well as accounting for regional or local biogeophysical effects of human activities that affect surface albedo or local climate
definition.fr: activités humaines qui n’ont aucune incidence nette sur le système climatique car elles équilibrent les émissions résiduelles par l’élimination des émissions (de dioxyde de carbone) et tiennent compte des effets biogéophysiques régionaux ou locaux des activités humaines ayant une incidence sur l'albedo ou sur le climat local

definition.en: levy on imported goods to counter carbon leakage, in order to avoid industries in countries with stricter rules being penalised
definition.fr: taxe appliquée aux produits importés afin de lutter contre la fuite de carbone, afin d'éviter que les entreprises de pays appliquant des règles plus strictes se retrouvent pénalisées

definition.en: combination of the perceived variables visual attractiveness, perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use and perceived risk of a product or service
definition.fr: association des variables perçues telles que l’attrait visuel, l’utilité, la facilité d’utilisation et le risque perçu concernant un produit ou un service

definition.en: movement to disinvest from coal, oil and gas companies, with the intention of combating climate change by reducing the amount of greenhouse gases released into the atmosphere, and holding the oil, gas and coal companies responsible for their role in climate change
definition.fr: tendance à se désinvestir des sociétés charbonnières, pétrolières et gazières, avec l’intention de lutter contre le changement climatique en réduisant la quantité de gaz à effet de serre rejetés dans l’atmosphère, et en tenant les entreprises pétrolières, gazières et charbonnières pour responsables du rôle qu’elles jouent dans le changement climatique

definition.en: framework for integrated assessments where social and economic developments exert pressure on the environment by changing the state of the environment and impacting  human health, ecosystems and materials
definition.fr: cadre pour des évaluations intégrées dans lesquelles l’évolution sociale et économique exerce une pression sur l’environnement en modifiant l’état de l’environnement et en ayant une incidence sur la santé humaine, les écosystèmes et les ressources

definition.en: form of environmental regulation and development where a company can voluntarily choose to comply with predefined processes or objectives set forth by the certification service
definition.fr: processus permettant le développement dans le respect de l'environnement, par lequel une entreprise peut volontairement choisir de se conformer à des objectifs ou exigences prédéfinis par le service de certification

name.fr: label de l’UE pour les obligations vertes

definition.en: any type of listed or unlisted bond or capital market debt instrument issued by a European or international issuer that is aligned with the EU GBS
definition.fr: tout type d’obligations ou d’instruments de financement sur le marché des capitaux d'emprunt cotés ou non cotés émis par un émetteur européen ou international qui est conforme à la norme de l’UE applicable aux obligations vertes

name.fr: norme de l’UE applicable aux obligations vertes

definition.en: proposed voluntary framework, based on the association with the EU sustainability taxonomy, of core components for EU Green Bonds to enhance the effectiveness, transparency, accountability, comparability and credibility of the green bond market and to increase the flow of finance towards green and sustainable projects
definition.fr: proposition de cadre volontaire, fondé sur l’association avec la taxonomie européenne de la durabilité, des composantes essentielles des obligations vertes de l’UE, visant à renforcer l’efficacité, la transparence, la responsabilité, la comparabilité et la crédibilité du marché des obligations vertes et à accroître le flux de financement vers des projets verts et durables

name.fr: de la ferme à la table

definition.en: component of the EU strategy for sustainable food aiming to keep food safe, nutritious and of high quality by enhancing the environmental sustainability of the food system, involving all actors along the value chain
definition.fr: composante de la stratégie de l’UE pour une alimentation durable visant à garantir une alimentation saine, nutritive et de haute qualité en améliorant la durabilité environnementale du système alimentaire et en associant tous les acteurs tout au long de la chaîne de valeur

definition.en: area next to a river bed which is more or less frequently covered with water in times of high water discharges from adjacent rivers
definition.fr: zone située à proximité d’un lit de cours d’eau, qui est plus ou moins fréquemment recouvert d’eau en période de grands débits

definition.en: uphill retraction of the lowest point of a glacier because ice melts or ablates more quickly than snowfall can accumulate and form new glacial ice
definition.fr: montée en altitude du point le plus bas d’un glacier, parce que la glace fond ou se retire plus vite que les chutes de neige ne peuvent s’accumuler et former de nouvelles glaces

definition.en: activity producing goods and services to measure, prevent, limit, minimise or correct environmental damage to water, air and soil, as well as problems related to waste, noise and eco-systems, including technologies, products and services that reduce environmental risk, minimise pollution and resources
definition.fr: activité produisant des biens et des services permettant de mesurer, de prévenir, de limiter, de réduire au minimum ou de corriger les dommages environnementaux causés à l’eau, à l’air et au sol, ainsi que les problèmes liés aux déchets, au bruit et aux écosystèmes, y compris les technologies, produits et services qui réduisent le risque pour l’environnement, réduisent au minimum la pollution et les ressources

definition.en: incorporation of climate risks into banks' risk management policies by supporting financial institutions that contribute to funding sustainable projects
definition.fr: intégration des risques climatiques dans les politiques de gestion des risques des banques en soutenant les établissements financiers qui contribuent au financement de projets durables

definition.en: sustainable product designed to minimise its environmental impact during the whole life-cycle, and even after it is of no use, to reduce waste and maximise resource efficiency
definition.fr: produit durable conçu pour réduire au minimum ses impacts sur l’environnement pendant tout son cycle de vie, et même lorsqu'il n'est plus utilisé, afin de réduire les déchets et d’optimiser l’utilisation rationnelle des ressources

definition.en: benefit-making resource with economic value that is negatively related to the risk of global warming and carbon emissions
definition.fr: ressource générant du profit ayant une valeur économique, et qui est liée négativement au risque de réchauffement climatique et aux émissions de carbone

definition.en: period of abnormally hot weather
definition.fr: période au cours de laquelle les chaleurs sont particulièrement fortes

name.fr: transition vers une économie à faible intensité de carbone

definition.en: process or change  towards a low carbon economy and society, through concrete steps, policies and legislation aimed to deliver major reductions in greenhouse gas emission across all economic sectors and activities in a way that maximises economic opportunities, is socially fair and protects the most vulnerable
definition.fr: processus ou changement en vue d’une économie et d’une société à faibles émissions de carbone, par le moyen de  mesures, de politiques et d’une législation concrètes, visant à réduire considérablement les émissions de gaz à effet de serre dans l’ensemble des secteurs et activités économiques en maximisant les possibilités économiques, en protégeant les plus vulnérables et en étant équitable sur le plan social

definition.en: efficient, sustainable use of resources by minimising the impact on the environment,  creating more with less throughout the entire lifecycle, from material extraction, resource use and maintenance to material recovery
definition.fr: utilisation efficace et durable des ressources en réduisant au minimum les impacts sur l’environnement, en créant plus avec moins tout au long du cycle de vie, depuis l’extraction des matières premières, l’utilisation des ressources et la maintenance jusqu’à la récupération des matières

definition.en: cost-effective approach that uses nature to deliver a range of critical services (wetlands for flood mitigation, carbon sequestration, improved air quality) that provides environmental, social and economic benefits, helping to build resilience by bringing more natural features and processes into the cities, landscapes and seascapes through locally adapted, resource-efficient and systemic interventions
definition.fr: approche rentable qui utilise la nature pour fournir une série de services essentiels (zones humides pour atténuer les inondations, piégeage du carbone, amélioration de la qualité de l’air) et apporte des avantages environnementaux, sociaux et économiques en contribuant à renforcer la résilience en apportant davantage de caractéristiques et de processus naturels dans les villes et les paysages terrestres et marins grâce à des interventions adaptées au niveau local, efficaces dans l’utilisation des ressources et systémiques

definition.en: globally balanced anthropogenic CO2 emissions through anthropogenic CO2 removals over a specified period
definition.fr: émissions anthropiques de CO2 globalement équilibrées par des absorptions anthropiques de CO2 sur une période donnée

definition.en: visual presentation of the distribution of sound-pressure levels due to given noise sources across a geographic area and for a defined time period
definition.fr: présentation visuelle de la distribution des niveaux de pression acoustique dus à des sources de bruit données dans une zone géographique et pour une période définie

definition.en: excessive consumption or use of goods and services (energy, land, water or materials) that cause harm or detrimental effects to humans and/or the environment, namely by exceeding the carrying capacity and life supporting systems of the planet and its ecosystems
definition.fr: consommation ou utilisation excessive de biens et de services (énergie, terre, eau ou matériaux) causant un préjudice ou des effets néfastes à l’homme et/ou à l’environnement, notamment en dépassant les capacités de charge et les mécanismes régulateurs de la biosphère de la planète et de ses écosystèmes

definition.en: area with a pleasant soundscape and in which noise, i.e. unwanted sound, is absent or at least not dominant
definition.fr: espace présentant un environnement sonore agréable et dans lequel le bruit, c'est-à-dire le son indésirable, est absent ou ne prédomine pas

definition.en: change based on the identification, evaluation and prioritisation of the risks involved, followed by the application of resources to minimise, monitor and control the probability/impact of events or to maximise the realisation of opportunities
definition.fr: changement fondé sur l’identification, l’évaluation et la hiérarchisation des risques encourus, suivie de l’application de ressources pour limiter, surveiller et contrôler la probabilité/l’incidence des événements ou pour maximiser la réalisation des opportunités

definition.en: any type of bond instrument where the proceeds will be exclusively applied to finance, refinance or raise funds in part or in full for new and existing projects with positive social outcomes
definition.fr: tout type d’instrument obligataire dont le rendement sera exclusivement utilisé pour financer, refinancer ou collecter des fonds en tout ou en partie pour des projets nouveaux et existants produisant des résultats positifs sur le plan social

name.fr: évaluation des risques en matière de durabilité

definition.en: identifying and analysing potential events that may negatively impact sustainability and evaluating that risk
definition.fr: processus consistant à identifier et analyser les événements susceptibles de nuire à la durabilité, puis à évaluer ce risque

definition.en: initial analysis of the potential positive or negative contribution of a proposal to sustainability
definition.fr: analyse initiale de l’éventuelle contribution positive ou négative d’une proposition en matière de durabilité

definition.en: integration of environmental, social and governance criteria into traditional banking operational and business activities
definition.fr: intégration de critères environnementaux, sociaux et de gouvernance dans les activités traditionnelles, pour les activités bancaires opérationnelles et les activités commerciales

definition.en: process of taking due account of environmental and social considerations in investment decision-making, leading to increased investments in longer-term and sustainable activities
definition.fr: processus de prise en compte des aspects environnementaux et sociaux dans la prise de décision en matière d’investissement, conduisant à des investissements accrus dans des activités durables et à plus long terme

definition.en: system viewed in a holistic manner by examining the linkages and interactions between the elements that comprise the whole of the system
definition.fr: système considéré de manière globale en examinant les liens et interactions entre les éléments qui composent l’ensemble du système

definition.en: change required when efforts to change one aspect of a system fail to fix the problem and the whole system needs to be transformed, namely the fundamental qualities of the system itself, through innovation, experimentation, constant learning and adaptation
definition.fr: changement requis lorsque les efforts visant à changer un aspect d’un système ne permettent pas de résoudre le problème et lorsque l’ensemble du système doit être transformé, à savoir les qualités fondamentales du système lui-même, grâce à l’innovation, l’expérimentation, l’apprentissage constant et l’adaptation

definition.en: framework to facilitate sustainable investment by establishing an EU-wide classification system to provide firms and investors with a common framework for identifying to what degree economic activities can be considered to be 'environmentally sustainable'
definition.fr: cadre visant à favoriser les investissements durables en établissant un système de classification à l’échelle de l’UE afin de fournir aux entreprises et aux investisseurs un référentiel commun permettant de déterminer dans quelle mesure les activités économiques peuvent être considérées comme «durables du point de vue environnemental»

definition.en: systematic long-term risk mispricing and reduction of the diversity of investments between issuers of securities (mostly long-term), intermediaries (mostly short-term) and beneficiaries (mostly long-term) that leads to a short-term focus on risk metrics and incentives, amplifying the mispricing of actual risk and opportunities
definition.fr: mauvaise évaluation systématique des risques à long terme et réduction de la diversité des investissements entre les émetteurs de valeurs mobilières (principalement à long terme), les intermédiaires (principalement à court terme) et les bénéficiaires (principalement à long terme) donnant lieu à une approche à court terme axée sur les indicateurs de risque et les mesures d’incitation, amplifiant la sous-évaluation des risques et possibilités réels

definition.en: removal or diversion of water from the water environment
definition.fr: prélèvement d'eau, par  retrait ou détournement de l’eau de l’environnement aquatique

name.ar: المحيط البشري (بيئة مبنية، مستوطنات بشرية، إعداد الأرض)
name.en: ANTHROPOSPHERE (built environment, human settlements, land setup)
name.fr: ANTHROPOSPHERE (environnement bâti, implantations humaines, aménagement du territoire)

name.ar: المحيط المائي (ماء عذب، ماء البحر، مياه)
name.fr: HYDROSPHERE (eau douce, eau de mer, eaux)

name.en: ADMINISTRATION, MANAGEMENT, POLICY, POLITICS, INSTITUTIONS, PLANNING
